slides.summary: Three Italian friends spent two days scouring a Tuscan mountain stream, found an Irishman's lost wedding ring wedged in the rapids, then flew to Ireland dressed as hobbits to hand it back.
slides.headline: Friends find lost wedding ring in Irish stream
slides.proves: Filippo Palagi, Nicola Malloggi and Edoardo Poggi now call Patrick Mohr's family in Ireland their own after the visit.

slides.summary: Dale, 86, has spent 39 years welding a 62-foot steel boat in his Mineral Wells, Texas yard, and strangers have now raised over $41,000 from 1,500 donors to help him finish it and reach the water.
slides.headline: Strangers raise 41000 dollars to help Dale finish his boat
slides.proves: The GoFundMe is already close to the $45,000 needed to move the boat down the hill and get it to a launch site.

slides.summary: Colorado's 200-foot grass-covered overpass on Interstate 25 helped cut wildlife collisions on that stretch by 91%, from 32 crashes a year down to two in 10 months.
slides.headline: Wildlife overpass cuts collisions by 91 percent
slides.proves: Elk and pronghorn herds split by the highway for decades could begin interbreeding again, with genetic testing planned in five to ten years to check.

slides.summary: China's five national parks saw Siberian tigers rise from 27 to 72 and Amur leopards from 42 to 115 since 2021, while Tibetan antelope topped 70,000, up from under 20,000 in 2015.
slides.headline: Siberian tigers rise from 27 to 72 in China parks
slides.proves: Nearly 50,000 local residents earning up to 21,000 yuan a year as rangers show conservation can also be a livelihood.

slides.summary: The Amazon lost just 693,000 hectares to deforestation in 2025, the lowest annual total in the 41-year MapBiomas record.
slides.headline: Amazon deforestation hits lowest level in 41 years
